# The Innovators Den

> The Innovators Den is a premium cultural news app and media brand built "For Us, By Us." We deliver curated, brand-safe content across 11 topics — Innovation, Art, Culture, Music, Business Growth, Sports, Food & Wine, Health, Travel, Astrology, and Law — focused on Black excellence, entrepreneurship, and the innovator lifestyle.

## About

The Innovators Den is a Black-owned media company operating a mobile news app (iOS & Android) and a growing digital media presence. Our editorial voice centers Black culture, innovation, and upward mobility. We cover the stories, creators, businesses, athletes, artists, and thinkers shaping our future.

Our tagline: **For Us, By Us.**

## Topics We Cover

- **Innovation** — Black tech founders, STEM trailblazers, emerging technology, startups
- **Art** — Black visual artists, exhibitions, galleries, culture-defining creatives
- **Culture** — NYC, ATL, MIA, LA scenes; Black lifestyle, style, and community
- **Music** — Hip-hop, R&B, Afrobeats, gospel; artists, tours, new releases
- **Business Growth** — Black entrepreneurship, finance, wealth building, real estate
- **Sports** — NBA, NFL, track and field, tennis; Black athletes winning on and off the field
- **Food & Wine** — Black-owned restaurants, chefs, food culture, culinary arts
- **Health** — Wellness, mental health, fitness, nutrition for Black communities
- **Travel** — Destination guides, travel culture, diaspora experiences
- **Astrology** — Horoscopes, astrology culture, spiritual wellness
- **Law** — Legal rights, business law, tax advice, justice news

## App

- iOS App: Available on the Apple App Store under "The Innovators Den"
- Android App: Available on Google Play under "The Innovators Den"
- Bundle ID: com.theinnovatorsden.app

## Podcast

The Innovators Den Podcast — available on Apple Podcasts and YouTube. New episodes dropping soon.

## Brand

- Primary Color: #000000 (Black)
- Accent Color: #FFE600 (Neon Yellow)
- Highlight Color: #FF4D7E (Hot Pink)
- Founded: 2024
- Mission: To be the definitive cultural news platform for Black innovators, entrepreneurs, creatives, and culture leaders

## Content Standards

All content published by The Innovators Den is:
- Brand-safe and family-friendly (filtered against IAB brand safety categories)
- Politically neutral (no partisan coverage)
- Sourced from reputable publishers including TechCrunch, Bloomberg, The Root, EBONY, The Grio, Hollywood Reporter, and 40+ premium RSS feeds
- Updated daily via automated ingestion
